areaProgressHints.unlockClaim: Main mission 'Lost in the Marsh' provides access
Main mission 'The Way of Water' leads into Wuling City
After main Chapter II Process III: Surging From a Withered Spring, unlock side mission Deep Vaulted Steel; mission proceeds to Sword Vault Dale
Official in-game tutorial says gear templates in Marker Stone require Hetonite Components; not an area unlock condition
Optional area can be accessed through Typhoeus narrative event A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods

All the Inky Hues event requires reaching main mission Chapter II Process VIII: Enter the Painted World and objective Meet up with Si at the designated location; event participation requirement, NOT necessarily earliest region access
Major portion of Chapter II Process IV takes place in Marker Stone; does not prove exact first access
Wuling City has a geographic route to Yinglung Pass; Chapter II Process VII is associated with the area, but actual entry trigger is unverified
Accessible via Wuling City; associated with Chapter II Process III. Access mission trigger not independently confirmed
